[[File:24 Trading Card Game original logo.png|thumb|right|180px|Original 24 TCG logo.]]
The '''24 Trading Card Game''' is a Press Pass game based on the television series ''24''. The rulebook credits Jason Winter and Trevor McGregor with lead design.<ref name="twenty-four-original-rules">[https://ccggamez.com/files/24/24%20TCG%20-%20Rulebook.pdf 24 Trading Card Game Rulebook], Press Pass, 2007, credits on p. 29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160707053641/http://ccggamez.com/files/24/24%20TCG%20-%20Rulebook.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="twenty-four-trade">[https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/11738/press-pass-holiday-special Press Pass Holiday Special], ICv2, 6 December 2007. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107201303/https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/11738/press-pass-holiday-special Internet Archive].</ref> Press Pass released ''Day 0 Tactical Packs'' and ''Basic Training'' in August 2007, followed by ''First Edition'' in September.<ref name="twenty-four-products">[https://www.ccgtrader.net/games/24-tcg/ 24 TCG], CCG Trader, original product list and cancellation account. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260121115713/https://www.ccgtrader.net/games/24-tcg/ Internet Archive].</ref> According to CCG Trader, Press Pass canceled the game in April 2008.<ref name="twenty-four-products" />

Players lead CTU or the Insurgents and send characters on missions to score 24 points.<ref name="twenty-four-original-rules" />

== Playing online ==

[[TCGMix]] offers a [https://tcgmix.com/twentyfour/ browser playtest].<ref name="twenty-four-online">[https://tcgmix.com/twentyfour/ 24 TCG on TCGMix]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107193938/https://tcgmix.com/twentyfour/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="catalog" />
